content.test_md_blob:
# Clear the selected performance point when the time range changes

> Prove changing the time range clears any previously selected chart point after a lock has been established.

## Step 1

Open {{portfolio_overview_url}} in a browser and wait for the Portfolio Overview workspace to finish loading with the Portfolio Performance card visible.

## Step 2

On the Portfolio Performance chart, hover and click a visible data point so the chart enters a locked selection state with its tooltip and lock icon visible.

## Step 3

capture baseline: locked selected chart point before the time-range change.

## Step 4

Change the time-range control from the current selection to a different supported value, using 3M if it is not already active or 1Y otherwise.

## Step 5

Confirm the previously locked point is cleared, no selected point remains locked, the new range is the only active value, and the chart range, x-axis labels, and displayed period comparison refresh from the locked-point baseline context.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-11, ac-12, ac-13, ac-15, ac-25

Confirm state-transition check: no selected chart point (equals) — the stated promise: Changing the time range clears the selected chart point.
